snippet.title: Mafdet And The Book Of The Dead (Amiga Longplay)
snippet.description:
Unleashed onto the beloved Amiga in 1989 by Software Horizons.

Set in Egyptian mythology, you play Mafdet, the Cat Goddess Of Revenge. The evil god Seth has stolen the Book Of The Dead and hidden it deep within the underworld. Unless it's recovered then nobody can enter the afterlife when they die. So you better bloody find it, otherwise this existence will be your last.

Being a cat goddess, you naturally begin with 9 lives. Pressing space transforms you into a mighty feline or a steroid induced shot-putter, depending on which guise you currently occupy. The downside of transforming is that you forfeit a life!

Fortunately you only need to transform once, after entering the temple (cats are forbidden from walking into temples it would seem).

Released for £14.99 this truly is an epic game, and one that all genuine retro gamers should spend many hours, if not days continuously playing.

Oh yes folks, it's an absolute blockbuster. In fact, ZeusDaz adores this so much he begged me to create a longplay following his recent review.

ZeusDaz' review:  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xAXN5CGxkHE
